TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Add Currently Processed Flat File Name Port

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: This mapping gets different counts on the PseudoSSN file that was processed and loads them to the Counters Table.
MAPPING.NAME: m_Pseudossn_Counters

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Gets the Pay Period processed in the table PSEUDOSSN_TBL
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: lkp_PSEUDOSSN_TBL_Pay_Period

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT MIN(PSEUDOSSN_TBL.PP_NUM) as PP_NUM, MIN(PSEUDOSSN_TBL.PP_END_YEAR) as PP_END_YEAR FROM PSEUDOSSN_TBL

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: This transformation sets the mapping variables MAP_SUBJECT and MAP_MESSAGE using the counters and descriptions set in the previous expression transformation.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: exp_Build_Message

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: v_ENVIRONMENT || 'Pseudo SSN loaded successfully for Pay Period: ' || TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_SUBJECT

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
'Number of Detail Records from PseudoSSN file = ' || TO_CHAR(COUNTER_1) ||
CHR(10) ||
'Number of Records loaded = ' || TO_CHAR(COUNTER_2) ||
CHR(10) ||
'Number of Duplicate Records = ' || TO_CHAR(COUNTER_3)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_MESSAGE

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Determines Detail records to be used for further processing.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: exp_Determine_Detail

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE (TRUE, SUBSTR(SSN,1, 6) = 'HEADER', 'H', SUBSTR(SSN,1, 7) = 'TRAILER', 'T', 'D')
--Count header and detail records.
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(v_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG = 'H' OR v_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG = 'D' AND LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(SSN))) > 0, v_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG, 'R')
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Performs a count on all Detail Records.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: agg_ALL_RECORDS

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Performs a count on all duplicates that were sent to the Error Table.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: lkp_Count_PSEUDOSSN_Duplicates_ERROR_TABLE

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT FROM ERROR_TBL a,
(SELECT MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE FROM ERROR_TBL b1 WHERE b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND b1.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl' AND SUBSTR(b1.ERROR_MESSAGE, 3, 9) = 'duplicate' ) b
WHERE a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE AND a.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl'

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: 'Number of detail records from the PSEUDOSSN file.'
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNTER_DESCRIPTION_1

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: 'Number of detail records loaded to the PSEUDOSSN table.'
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNTER_DESCRIPTION_2

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Performs a count on all records loaded to table Pseudossn_TBL
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: lkp_Count_PSEUDOSSN_TBL

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT FROM PSEUDOSSN_TBL
